map.：创可贴（割伤擦伤）、无菌纱布+医用胶带（包扎较大伤口）、碘伏棉签（伤口消毒）、: : Adhesive plasters (cuts and grazes), sterile gauze plus medical tape (dressing larger wounds), povidone-iodine swabs (wound disinfection), saline (flushing wounds or eyes), elastic bandage (compression for sprains), disposable gloves (avoiding cross-infection), scissors (cutting bandages or clothing), thermometer, tourniquet (severe limb bleeding, note the time of application), burn ointment, antihistamine, torch, emergency blanket (keeping warm when hypothermic).

map.清单能代替专业急救指导吗？: Can the list replace professional first aid guidance?
map.不能。清单仅帮助备齐物品，受伤处理请遵专业急救流程或就医；止血带等器械使用需培训: No. The list only helps you prepare the items; for treating injuries follow professional first aid procedures or see a doctor, and devices such as tourniquets require training to use.
map.药品多久检查一次？: How often should medicines be checked?
map.建议每 3–6 个月核对有效期与完好度，过期或受潮变质立即更换；急救毯、绷带等耗: Check expiry dates and condition every 3-6 months is advised, and replace immediately anything expired or degraded by moisture; consumables such as emergency blankets and bandages also need regular restocking.
